title: Incomplete identity intake
summary: Retain unknown or partial birth information without fabricating a patient birth date, then resolve it to a verified patient or record that it was declined.

sections.title: Identity before testing
paragraphs: An incomplete intake record retains supplied evidence. It is not a patient identity or test order. Source documents remain a separate custody question; typed references and text do not retain their original bytes.

pages.title: Incomplete identity intake
pages.purpose: Record and reconcile intake when only an unknown or partial birth date or a supplied age is available, find intake by name or source reference, and see how long open intake has waited.
pages.access: Enter orders capability for the list, recording and dispositions; every list read is audited. View in audit trail needs View the audit trail.

fields.name: Find
fields.meaning: Searches the intake records by part of the name as supplied or of the source reference, for example a requisition number.
fields.values: Free text, blank initially. Placeholder: Name or source reference. Matches anywhere in either value, ignoring the case of unaccented letters; % and _ match themselves.
fields.rules: Applied after a pause in typing, or at once with Enter; Escape or the X in the field clears it. The engine searches before paging, so Load more continues the same matches, and the Show counts follow the find text. The text names a person, so it is not kept in the address. At most 200 characters; longer text is refused.

fields.name: Show
fields.meaning: Which intake records the list shows, each choice with how many intake records match the find text.
fields.values: Awaiting verified identity (the default), Resolved, Declined or All, for example “Awaiting verified identity (2)”. All counts the three together.
fields.rules: Kept in the address as ?show=awaiting, resolved, declined or all, so the work queue's link, Back and reload keep it; an unknown value shows open intake. Changing it starts a new list of up to 50 records.

fields.name: Name as supplied (column)
fields.meaning: The name exactly as the source gave it.
fields.rules: Not a patient record and not a patient match.

fields.name: Birth information (column)
fields.values: The form's labels followed by the supplied text: Unknown (alone when no text was supplied), “Partial date: 1985” or “Supplied age: About 40”.
fields.rules: The supplied text is shown exactly as entered; nothing is completed or converted to a birth date.

fields.name: Source reference (column)
fields.meaning: Where the evidence came from, as recorded.

fields.name: Received (column)
fields.values: Date and time in the laboratory time zone.

fields.name: Waiting (column)
fields.meaning: How long open intake has waited for verified identity since it was recorded.
fields.values: Under 1 hour, then whole hours (for example 5 hours), then whole days (for example 2 days); — once a disposition is recorded.
fields.rules: Worked out when the list is shown; Refresh brings it up to date.

fields.name: Disposition (column)
fields.values: A badge: Awaiting verified identity (warning: a person must act), Resolved or Declined (neutral: final).
fields.rules: A disposition is final and cannot be changed or reopened.

fields.name: Intake side panel
fields.meaning: Clicking an intake, pressing Enter on it or choosing Open in its row menu opens it in a side panel titled “Intake: <name as supplied>” with its Disposition badge: Birth information, Source reference, Reason and Recorded (time and person); after a disposition, also Disposition source, Disposition reason, Disposition recorded and, for a resolved intake, Patient.
fields.values: Read-only. The open intake is kept in the address (?open=), so Back and reload keep it open.
fields.rules: The original evidence never changes; a resolution keeps the unknown, partial or age evidence as supplied. Issued artifacts and patient identity holds do not change.

fields.name: Name as supplied
fields.meaning: Record incomplete identity intake: the source name retained before patient registration.
fields.rules: Surrounding spaces are removed; not a patient match or a newly registered patient.

fields.name: Available birth information
fields.meaning: Record incomplete identity intake: the kind of birth evidence actually available.
fields.values: Unknown, Partial date or Supplied age; nothing is preselected.
fields.rules: Required. Do not convert an age to a date or complete a partial date.

fields.name: Exact supplied date or age text
fields.meaning: Record incomplete identity intake: the source text retained without deriving a complete date.
fields.values: Required, and marked with an asterisk, when Available birth information is Partial date or Supplied age; optional for Unknown; at most 200 characters.
fields.rules: Left blank for Partial date or Supplied age, the form stops before saving with “Enter the partial date or age exactly as supplied.” The engine checks it again. Surrounding spaces are removed; the text itself is kept as entered. Not exact source-file custody.

fields.name: Source reference and Reason intake is deferred
fields.meaning: Record incomplete identity intake: where the evidence came from and why complete identity is unavailable.
fields.values: Both required, at most 1,000 characters each.
fields.rules: Stored on the original record, which cannot be changed; not copied into diagnostic logs.

fields.name: Choose verified patient
fields.meaning: The dialog opened by Resolve with verified patient: explicit selection of an existing patient after obtaining source-backed complete identity.
fields.values: The patient directory with Find by name, birth date or identifier and its detailed search; no patient preselected.
fields.rules: Register verified patient opens normal matching and registration. Return and choose the patient explicitly; no link is inferred from the intake name.

fields.name: Verification or decline source and Disposition reason
fields.meaning: Resolve incomplete identity intake or Record declined intake: the evidence for the resolution or for declining.
fields.values: Both required, at most 1,000 characters each; blank initially.
fields.rules: Resolved must link an existing patient; declined has no patient link. A disposition recorded meanwhile makes the dialog's revision stale and the engine refuses it.

actions.name: Record incomplete intake / Retain incomplete intake
actions.does: Opens Record incomplete identity intake and saves the supplied evidence as a separate intake record that cannot be changed.
actions.availableWhen: Enter orders capability; all required fields valid.
actions.result: Shows “Incomplete intake retained”. No patient, order or test is created; the intake waits under Awaiting verified identity.

actions.name: Open
actions.does: Row menu (⋯): opens the intake in the side panel, as clicking the row does.
actions.result: The side panel shows the intake; nothing changes.

actions.name: Resolve with verified patient / Register verified patient
actions.does: From the side panel or the row menu: opens Choose verified patient, to find the verified patient or use the registration workflow after obtaining a full source-backed identity.
actions.availableWhen: Intake awaiting verified identity; Enter orders capability.
actions.result: Choosing a patient opens Resolve incomplete identity intake, where the selection is reviewed in the identity banner and Record disposition is still required. Cancel closes the dialog without a change.

actions.name: Record declined intake / Record disposition
actions.does: From the side panel or the row menu: Record declined intake opens its dialog; Record disposition records an attributed final decline or resolution with source and reason.
actions.availableWhen: Intake awaiting verified identity, at the revision shown; a resolution needs a chosen existing patient.
actions.result: Shows “Intake disposition recorded”; the intake moves to Resolved or Declined and its actions disappear. The original evidence remains. This does not create an order, merge patients or remove identity holds.

actions.name: View in audit trail
actions.does: From the row menu or the link at the bottom of the side panel: opens the Audit trail filtered on this intake record.
actions.availableWhen: View the audit trail capability; otherwise the item and the link are not shown.
actions.result: The Audit trail lists the intake's recording and disposition events. Viewing the trail is itself recorded.

actions.name: Open resolved patient
actions.does: Side panel, Patient: navigates to the linked patient.
actions.availableWhen: Resolved intake with a patient link.
actions.result: Review identity and holds before entering any order.

actions.name: Refresh / Load more intake records
actions.does: Reloads the list, the counts and the open intake, or loads the next 50 records of the same Show filter and find text.
actions.availableWhen: Load more appears while more records match.
actions.result: A disposition recorded meanwhile shows at once in the open intake and its actions disappear; under Awaiting verified identity the intake leaves the list, and the panel offers Show all intake.

actions.name: Close (X), Escape, Previous / Next, Back to list, Cancel
actions.does: Close (X) or Escape closes the side panel; Previous and Next open the intake before or after it in the list's current order; on a narrow window the panel replaces the list and Back to list returns to it. Cancel abandons unsaved dialog fields.
actions.availableWhen: An intake is open; Escape works while focus is in the panel. Previous and Next are disabled at the ends of the list.
actions.result: No clinical data is removed. A pending intake remains pending.

actions.name: Show all intake
actions.does: Shown in the side panel when the intake in the address is not in the list shown: switches Show to All.
actions.result: The intake opens again if it still matches the find text.

restrictions: No testing or order authority arises from incomplete intake. Never fabricate a full birth date.
Terminal disposition cannot be edited or reopened; the original intake is retained. Identity matching, duplicate resolution and source-document custody remain separate.
workflow: Retain the supplied name, birth evidence, source and reason with Record incomplete intake.
Work the list under Show: Awaiting verified identity, oldest first; Waiting shows how long each has waited.
Obtain source-backed identity or an explicit decline decision.
For resolution, choose Resolve with verified patient, register or find the verified patient, compare the identity banner, and record the disposition with evidence.
Check the result under Show: Resolved or Declined, and use the linked patient workflow only when appropriate.

troubleshooting.problem: Not recorded because the record changed
troubleshooting.recovery: Cancel and Refresh; review the intake's current disposition in the side panel before taking another action.

troubleshooting.problem: Patient cannot be found or identity remains incomplete
troubleshooting.recovery: Keep the intake pending. Do not manufacture a birth date or register a duplicate to proceed.
Check the Show filter and its counts, clear Find, or record new incomplete intake when source evidence exists.

troubleshooting.problem: Retain incomplete intake stops with “Enter the partial date or age exactly as supplied.”
troubleshooting.recovery: Type the partial date or age exactly as the source gives it, or choose Unknown when the source gives neither.
